title: State v. Alvarez
facts: Victim reported wallet stolen at gunpoint outside a subway station
Two witnesses gave differing descriptions of the suspect's height
jury_instructions: Weigh conflicting eyewitness testimony carefully; eyewitness identification can be unreliable under stress.

evidence_items.content: Victim identified the defendant in a police lineup with high confidence.
Bystander described the suspect as significantly shorter than the defendant.
Subway station security footage, partially obscured by a pillar.
No fingerprints recovered from the scene.
